description: Read a bounded structural overview of the canonical zenitheye.net knowledge graph: node counts, edge count, registries, observation surfaces and provenance. Use knowledge_graph_search to locate nodes, knowledge_graph_node for one exact node, and knowledge_graph_neighbors to traverse explicit edges. This tool is read-only and grants no publication, mutation, provider-contact or execution authority.
name: knowledge_graph_overview
title: ZenithEye Knowledge Graph Overview
